# Abstract

Of 2104 patients, 482 died. The hazard ratio was 0.83 (95% CI 0.75–0.93). Mortality fell by 37%.

# Results

482 of 2104 patients (25.9%) died. In the second cohort, 49 (2%) of 2609 died, and 13/40 (35%) relapsed.
The odds ratio was 1·52 (95% CI 1·61–2·10). HR 0.83 (95% CI 0.75 to 0.93) in the main analysis.
The rate ratio was 1.2 (0.0–3.4). Uptake was 144 (71%) of 204.

Death occurred less often with drug (HR, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.75-0.93). The hazard ratio, 0.83; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.75 to 0.93) was stable.
Median age was 45 (30–60) years.
